source_message.text:
Alright, this should cover everything remaining:

1\. In the pricing section, delete one panel so that only 2 panels remain. Remove the most expensive panel. Restyle the section if necessary—for example, if this leaves too much empty space along the sides.
All of these are monthly pricing options, but they should be styled with 月 in smaller print than the pricing. Use the attached english\_monthly image as a reference for what I mean, where the English “mo” appears in smaller print than the price.

2\. In the q&a, delete one of the boxes. It should be the second-to-last box, directly above the final one that asks what to do if I have any questions.
3\. Once the above is complete, create a duplicate.
4\. In that duplicate, delete the entire pricing section.
5\. Then, beneath every button that was originally above the pricing panel, add a secondary button reading 👇跳到課程內容介紹👇
6\. Do not put a button wrapper around this secondary button.

Refer to the attached “secondary\_button” image for the intended appearance. The sole difference from that example is that our secondary button should sit directly underneath the primary button rather than beside it.
